lines.1: 「Huh? Why is my hair back to normal?」
lines.2: 「I was bored, so I tried fixing it.」
lines.3: 「Don't use me to kill time while I'm unconscious!」
lines.9: 「Well, I can't get mad when you took care of me.」
lines.10: 「But honestly? At this point, I kind of feel like you should take responsibility.」
lines.13: 「I mean, I'll take responsibility for making sure we have fun tomorrow.」
lines.15: 「We keep trying to outstubborn each other and winding up in fights...」
lines.16: 「Like you said, if we'd worked together today, we might've both relaxed and enjoyed the whole resort experience.」
lines.17: 「But instead, look what happened at the hot spring just now.」
lines.18: 「What a waste... We came all this way to an island down south. I've finally learned my lesson.」
lines.19: 「...Yeah. The hot spring was relaxing at first, too.」
lines.20: 「Tomorrow, I'll do my best to make sure you have fun.」
lines.21: 「...Yeah. We're here, so we might as well enjoy it.」
lines.22: 「...Now that we've settled that... Let's get some sleep.」
